arguments.command: $tmp="$env:TEMP\hone_final"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $tmp | Out-Null; Write-Output '=== CLI smoke ==='; python -m hone tests/fixtures/data_file/small_cats_dataset/dataset.csv "$tmp\out1.json"; Write-Output "file2file=$LASTEXITCODE"; python -m hone examples/example_c.csv - > "$tmp\out2.json"; Write-Output "file2stdout=$LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content examples/example_b.csv -Raw | python -m hone - "$tmp\out3.json"; Write-Output "stdin2file=$LASTEXITCODE"; Get-Content examples/example_a.csv -Raw | python -m hone - - > "$tmp\out4.json"; Write-Output "stdin2stdout=$LASTEXITCODE"; Write-Output '=== demo ==='; python examples/demo.py > "$tmp\demo.json"; Write-Output "demo=$LASTEXITCODE"; python -c "import json;d=json.load(open(r'$tmp\demo.json',encoding='utf-8'));print('demo_json_rows',len(d))"; Write-Output '=== exact stdout ==='; python -m hone examples/example_a.csv - > "$tmp\exact.txt"; python -c "import json;exp=json.load(open(r'$tmp\out4.json',encoding='utf-8'));t=open(r'$tmp\exact.txt',encoding='utf-8',newline='').read();print('exact_stdout', t==json.dumps(exp,indent=2,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')"; Write-Output '=== wheel ==='; python -m pip wheel . -w dist --no-deps -q 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2; Get-ChildItem dist | Select-Object Name,Length
